posts.title: The Plan Is Not the Prompt
posts.description: Long-running agents crash because the plan lives inside the model's head, which forgets. Move it into deterministic code, the outside plan, and treat the agent like dice on a boring table: replayable, scalable, and crash-proof.

posts.title: Boring Enough to Ignore
posts.description: You don't flow with a compiler because you watch it well. You flow because you stopped watching it. The craft of running agents is making their work boring enough to ignore.

posts.title: The Hand Trained the Eye
posts.description: We are automating the making and keeping the judging, on the assumption that judgment survives without the making. It doesn't, and the eye that only reviews starts grading the wrong thing.
